purpose: Milestone 9.7 Section 5: frozen M9.8 training recipe for HydroCore-M, inheriting the M9.6 winning recipe unchanged except architecture capacity.

optimizer_step_policy.rationale: Default M9.8 policy holds S and M optimizer-step budgets identical (both 1350) to isolate model capacity while holding data exposure and optimization opportunity fixed, per protocol Section 5. M does NOT receive more steps because it is larger.
optimizer_step_policy.compute_comparability_reasoning: Explicitly checked: hydroswarm.training.trainer._scheduler(optimizer, config, total_steps) builds its LambdaLR multiplier purely as a function of config.warmup_steps/config.scheduler and the total_steps argument -- it takes no dependency on model parameter count, d_model, or any architecture-derived quantity. Therefore scheduler construction does NOT mathematically depend on parameter count for this codebase, and 'same 1350 optimizer steps' remains the fairest capacity comparison. No compute-comparability blocker was found; none is invented.

scheduler.note: ARM_A_SCHEDULER_TOTAL_STEPS=1500 (m9_6_common.SCHEDULER_TOTAL_STEPS) governs the cosine trajectory denominator identically for S and M; scheduler trajectory is a pure function of (config, total_steps), independent of model width -- see optimizer_step_policy.compute_comparability_reasoning.

optimizer.note: No size-dependent scaling (e.g. LR scaling by width) is defined anywhere in the frozen historical recipe; none is introduced for M9.8.

batch_microbatch.note: M9.7 engineering smoke (Section 9) verifies HydroCore-M fits the same CPU training configuration (device='cpu', fp32=True, batch_size=2) without requiring a physical microbatch-size change. If a future M9.8 execution environment requires a smaller physical microbatch for HydroCore-M due to memory, gradient_accumulation_steps MUST be increased proportionally to preserve effective_batch_size=8 and the exact optimizer-step/scheduler semantics above -- this is a preregistered compensation rule, not a silent effective-batch-size change, per protocol Section 5's explicit instruction.

training_depth_policy.policy: full-history depth=25 training only (ARM_POLICIES['A'] equivalent / full_history_policy), matching M9.6 ARM_B exactly

checkpoint_selection.policy: validation only (lowest validation loss across the run, per-family mean for interleaved training)

calibration.refit_policy: refit independently per architecture (S and M each get their own fit) per seed, from that architecture's own governed calibration-split rows -- never reusing S's quantiles for M (M9.1 protocol Section 11.2 precedent, carried forward)

development_use.policy: evaluation only, never optimization -- development_holdout/development-representative population used only to REPORT M9.8 results, never to select HydroCore-M's width/depth/dropout/optimizer/duration/parameter-count/calibration-scheme (protocol Sections 3 and 7's standing rule).

locked_splits.policy: locked_final_test and locked_topology_test remain unopened for the entirety of M9.7 and M9.8 screening/confirmation stages.

architecture_difference_from_S: capacity only (d_model 192->352, nhead 6->11, dim_feedforward 576->1056); see m9-7-selected-m-architecture.json / m9-7-semantic-parity-audit.json.
